def transform3(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(h):

            def get(y,x): return g[y][x] if 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w else None
            L,R,U,D=get(i,j-1),get(i,j+1),get(i-1,j),get(i+1,j)
            if L is not None and L==R: out[i][j]=L

from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            nb4=[g[y][x] for y,x in ((i-1,j),(i+1,j),(i,j-1),(i,j+1)) if 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w]
            if g[i][j] in nb4: continue
            c=Counter(nb4); best,maxn=None,-1
            for col,n in c.items():
                if n>maxn: best,maxn=col,n
            if [k for k,v in c.items() if v==maxn]!=[best]:
                nb8=[g[y][x] for y in range(max(0,i-1),min(h,i+2)) for x in range(max(0,j-1),min(w,j+2)) if (y,x)!=(i,j)]
                c8=Counter(nb8)
                # tie-break: color least common in 8-neighborhood among the tied ones
                best=min(c.items(), key=lambda kv:(c8[kv[0]], -kv[1]))[0]
            out[i][j]=best
